spotCheck.time: 1 Oct · exam morning · final tally at 6:04am
entries: Waste Management · Q1 · half wrong: CNG given for landfill gas; correct: methane/biogas. Why-tag: terminology mix-up. Redeemed on Q11 re-ask.
Transport · Q4 · wrong: Pune given instead of Kolkata among the Golden Quadrilateral cities. Why-tag: fact confusion. Redeemed on Q12 re-ask.

Soil · Q9 · wrong: red soil given for the leaching description; correct: laterite. Leaching is the laterite signature; red soil gets its colour from iron in the parent rock. Why-tag: laterite-vs-red distinction.

Waste Management · Q15 · half wrong: biomedical products given for the blue bin; correct: dry recyclables (paper, plastic, metal, glass). Biomedical waste is hazardous and handled separately. Why-tag: blue-bin contents.
Natural Vegetation · Q17 · wrong: moist deciduous given for Sundarbans mangroves; correct: tidal forests, at river mouths in salt water. Why-tag: forest-type mix-up.
Natural Vegetation · Q19 · wrong: sandalwood/teak/rosewood given for thorn forests; correct: kikar/acacia, babul, khair. Why-tag: evergreen-vs-thorn trees.
Transport · Q21 · half wrong: railway/waterway hedged answer; correct: waterways alone. Why-tag: answer hedging.
Natural Vegetation · Q22 · half wrong: Punjab/Karnataka given for sandalwood; correct answer for this question: Karnataka only. Why-tag: sandalwood state + answer hedging.
Soil · Q25 · wrong: Punjab/Haryana/UP given for black soil (the alluvial belt); correct: Deccan Trap, Maharashtra/Gujarat/MP. Why-tag: black-soil states + answer volleying.
Natural Vegetation · Q27 · unknown: Van Mahotsava; correct: annual tree-planting festival, first week of July, started in 1950. Why-tag: conservation facts.
Maps · Q29 · half: mountains = brown given, but plains = green omitted. Why-tag: incomplete answer.
Soil · Q30 · wrong: laterite given as best for paddy; correct: alluvial/clayey soil that holds standing water. Laterite grows rice with heavy rain and fertilizer. Why-tag: paddy soil.
priorities: Weakest: Natural Vegetation - tidal forests, thorn trees (kikar/babul/khair), Van Mahotsava (July, 1950), sandalwood (Karnataka).
Second: Soil - laterite vs red soil, black-soil states and paddy soil.
Answer pattern: hedging/volleying, giving multiple answers 3 times when asked for one.
spotCheck.full: Both original misses were redeemed on re-ask: methane/biogas and Golden Quadrilateral cities including Kolkata.
extras: Q13 was awarded full marks, but the extra alluvial-area claim was corrected from 80% to about 40% of India. Additional factual correction, not another scored miss. Why-tag: alluvial area %.
School map key: plateaus = ORANGE, checked against your notes in Q28. Mountains = brown; plains = green.

# Preboards full-syllabus scope (Year 2027 ICSE, all 10 subjects)
Compiled 17 Oct 2026. Sources: his "ICSE 10 notes - jm" Drive folder (7 subjects), CISCE Year 2027 official booklet (English, verified "YEAR 2027" Feb 2025), Oswal transcription of CISCE scope (Hindi, Computer Applications), futuretopper (maths units, labelled 2028; CISCE states no amendments for 2027).

## Physics (12) [his folder]
1 Force · 2 Work Energy Power · 3 Machines · 4 Refraction at Plane Surfaces · 5 Refraction Through a Lens · 6 Spectrum · 7 Sound · 8 Current Electricity · 9 Household Circuits · 10 Electro-Magnetism · 11 Calorimetry · 12 Radioactivity
Midterm covered 1-6, 8 (7 sound = tallentex only). NEW: 7 Sound, 9 Household Circuits, 10 Electro-Magnetism, 11 Calorimetry, 12 Radioactivity.

## Chemistry (11) [his folder]
1 Periodic Table · 2 Chemical Bonding · 3 Acids Bases Salts · 4 Analytical Chemistry · 5 Mole Concept & Stoichiometry · 6 Electrolysis · 7 Metallurgy · 8 Study of Compounds (HCl, Ammonia, H2SO4) · 9 Nitric Acid · 10 Organic Chemistry · (bonus: all-reactions compilation)
Midterm: all except Mole Concept (5), Nitric Acid (9) partially? Midterm list: HCl, H2SO4, ABS, analytical, practical + electrolysis, metallurgy, PT, CB, organic. NEW-ish: 5 Mole Concept, 9 Nitric Acid, Ammonia.

## Biology (15) [his folder]
1 Chromosomes/Cell Cycle/Division · 2 Genetics · 3 Absorption by Roots · 4 Transpiration · 5 Photosynthesis · 6 Chemical Coordination in Plants · 7 Circulatory · 8 Excretory · 9 Nervous · 10 Sense Organs · 11 Endocrine · 12 Reproductive · 13 Population · 14 Human Evolution · 15 Pollution
Midterm: 1-10, 13-15 (14 chapters). NEW: 11 Endocrine, 12 Reproductive.

## Maths (full ICSE units) [CISCE scope via futuretopper]
Commercial: GST · Banking (RD) · Shares & Dividends
Algebra: Linear Inequations · Quadratic Equations · Ratio & Proportion · Factorisation of Polynomials · Matrices · AP & GP · Coordinate Geometry (Section/Midpoint, Equation of a Line)
Geometry: Similarity · Loci · Circles · Constructions
Mensuration: Cylinder Cone Sphere
Trigonometry: Identities · Heights & Distances
Statistics: Graphical Representation · Measures of Central Tendency
Probability
Midterm = his 17 chapters. NEW: GST, Banking, Loci, Constructions, Trig Identities, GP part of AP&GP.

## History & Civics (19) [his folder]
Civics: 1 Union Legislature · 2 President & VP · 3 PM & Council of Ministers · 4 Supreme Court · 5 High Courts & Subordinate Courts
History: 6 First War of Independence 1857 · 7 Growth of Nationalism · 8 First Phase INC · 9 Second Phase INC · 10 Muslim League · 11 Gandhi & National Movement · 12 Quit India · 13 Forward Bloc/INA/Independence & Partition · 14 First World War · 15 Rise of Dictatorships · 16 Second World War · 17 United Nations · 18 UN Major Agencies · 19 Non-Aligned Movement
Midterm (his list): history 1,2,6,7,8,9 of his numbering (= 1857, Growth of Nat, Gandhi, Quit India, Forward Bloc, Independence/Partition) + civics 5,6 (Supreme Court, High Courts). NEW: civics 1-3 (Legislature, President, PM), history 8,9,10 (First/Second Phase INC, Muslim League), 14-19 (WW1, Dictatorships, WW2, UN, UN agencies, NAM).

## Geography (8 groups + map work) [his folder]
1 Interpretation of Topographical Maps · 2 Climate & Soil Resources · 3 Natural Vegetation & Water Resources · 4 Mineral & Energy Resources · 5 Agriculture I-IV · 6 Manufacturing Industries (agro + mineral) · 7 Transport · 8 Waste Management + India map pointing
Midterm: soil, nat veg, water, transport, waste I+II + maps. NEW: topo maps (1), climate (2a), minerals & energy (4), agriculture I-IV (5), manufacturing (6).

## English Literature (Class X list, CISCE Year 2027)
Drama: Julius Caesar Acts III, IV, V
Prose (5): With the Photographer · The Elevator · The Girl Who Can · The Pedestrian · The Last Lesson
Poetry (5): Haunted Houses · The Glove and the Lions · When Great Trees Fall · A Considerable Speck · The Power of Music
NEW vs midterm: With the Photographer, The Last Lesson, Haunted Houses, A Considerable Speck, JC Act V.

## English I (Language, CISCE Year 2027)
Composition (choice) · Letter · Comprehension (unseen passage) · Grammar (functional, no terms) · (internal: listening/speaking not preboard-relevant)

## Hindi (CISCE Year 2027; school offers Sahitya Sagar + Ekanki Sanchay)
Section A Language (40): Composition · Letter · Comprehension · Grammar
Section B Texts (40):
Sahitya Sagar stories (10): Baat Athanni Ki · Kaki · Maha Yagya Ka Puruskar · Netaji Ka Chasma · Apna Apna Bhagya · Bade Ghar Ki Beti · Sandeh · Bheed Me Khoya Aadmi · Bhede Aur Bhediyen · Do Kalakar
Ekanki Sanchay plays (6 listed): Sanskar Aur Bhavna · Bahu Ki Vida · Matri Bhoomi Ka Man · Sukhi Dali · Mahabharat Ki Ek Sanjh · Deepdan (verify if school list has more plays)
Midterm: Sandeh, Sukhi Dali, Deepdan, Bade Ghar Ki Beti, Bheed Mein Khoya Aadmi. NEW: 7 stories + ~4 plays. Poems + novel Naya Raasta NOT offered by his school (confirm at approval).

## Computer Applications (CISCE scope)
1 Revision of Class IX (OOP concepts, objects/classes, data types, operators, input, math library, conditionals, loops, nested loops) · 2 Class as Basis of Computation · 3 User-defined Methods · 4 Constructors · 5 Library Classes (wrappers) · 6 Encapsulation · 7 Arrays (1D/2D, sort, search) · 8 String Handling
